headline: Kinder Morgan Inc's Dividend Analysis
summary: Kinder Morgan Inc (NYSE:KMI) recently announced a total dividend of $0.3 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-08-03.  This upcoming payment includes a $0.3 per share cash dividend, payable on 2026-08-17.  As investors look forward to this payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.
